text:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout: redwood-service v2.7.0 -> 10% traffic (eu-west). Change window 22:00-23:00 UTC.
ryan: watching metrics, looks fine so far. @danielle can you double-check canary logs?
danielle: looking. seeing a few 502s in frontend proxy, small spike (0.6% -> 1.9%). pulling stack traces.
lucy: also seeing tail latency 95p jump +120ms on GPT routes. Could be kv-cache miss patterns.
samir: can we pause traffic shift if errors >1% or p95 > 200ms? what's current? @deploy-bot
deploy-bot: Canary metrics: errors=1.9% (threshold 1%), p95=280ms (threshold 200ms). Pausing further percentage increase.
ryan: hold. I'm going to pin the canary to v2.6.9 for the rest of eu-west while we investigate. Acceptable?
danielle: +1. Pinning prevents auto-shift, right?
deploy-bot: Pin applied: traffic pinned to v2.6.9 for eu-west customer tier default. Canary at 10% remains but new traffic won't go to v2.7.0.
lucy: capturing traces now, looks like a kernel selection fallback on long sequences, adds ~110ms.
samir: provisional action: gate rollout, open rollback ticket if can't resolve in 30m. I'll create the ticket.
samir: created ticket RW-4567 Rollback candidate + notes, assigning @ryan @lucy
ryan: experimenting turning off kv-cache eager-eviction flag on BETA hosts, will run a smoke test.
danielle: can we toggle to 5% instead of 10% to see behavior? maybe smaller window
lucy: prefer hold. 10% already crossing threshold. recommend rollback to v2.6.9 for canary group if no fix in 20m.
ryan: agree. If traces point to kernel fallback it's risky. I'll request rollback in 20m unless metrics improve.
oncall-bot: Alert: prod-eu-west latency SLO breach (5m window) — p95 > 250ms. paging @oncall
danielle: ping @ops for capacity checks, in case autoscales are interfering.
ryan: proposing stop/go: STOP further rollout, pin v2.6.9 globally for 30m, rollback option ready. Vote?
lucy: STOP. +1 to pin and rollback if we can't patch quickly.
samir: STOP. I'll run rollback if no improvement in 15m. :hourglass: \ndeploy-bot: Stop acknowledged. Halting percentage increases. Global default routing pinned to v2.6.9 for 30m.
ryan: logging final decision: hold rollout, pin v2.6.9, create rollback ticket RW-4567, action items: traces + kernel debug + kv cache config. Sync in #eng-releases in 30m. Thanks.
danielle: adding release notes comment and notifying sales about possible regression. :memo: 
lucy: will follow up with a short postmortem if rollback occurs. adding evals to catch regressions in future canary runs. :white_check_mark: 
deploy-bot: Canary status: paused at 10% (no further traffic increases). Next update in 10m or on manual resume.
